# Xelerate

> Fractional product management and custom development solutions for startups and scale-ups.

## About
Xelerate provides senior product leadership without the full-time salary. We offer fractional product management for $2,000/month and custom product & development solutions.

## Services
- [Product Leadership](https://xelerate.me/product-leadership): Fractional PM for $2,000/month — roadmaps, sprint rituals, stakeholder management, accountability
- [Custom Solutions](https://xelerate.me/custom-solutions): Bespoke product strategy, web development, MVP builds, and team augmentation
